summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded controls and perception experience across STM32, NVIDIA Jetson, and Raspberry Pi. Builds real-time features in embedded C++ and bare-metal C on Linux, with ROS1 and ROS2 stacks validated on physical UR5e and AL5B arms. OpenCV and Machine Learning development across industrial image-inspection pipelines, YOLO object detection, and segmentation models.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline in Python and OpenCV for microscopic crack analysis using custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and monocular depth estimation.
Designed an alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5 wavelet bank with concurrency-optimized homography stitching, raising PSNR from 65 to 86; profiled crack depth via ZoeDepth at plus/minus 8% error.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Led a culturally diverse team of 7 as the sole Machine Learning-experienced member, taking over as lead mid-project to deliver the full pipeline within the 6-week window.
Trained U-Net segmentation on the multi-modal BraTS 2020 MRI dataset with VGG-16/19 and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU for deployment trade-offs.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi over I2C and HC-05 Bluetooth, mapping 3-DoF hand motion to HID commands in Python.
Implemented z-axis differential tap detection; triaged and resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - M.S. Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system across a three-layer distributed pipeline (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson + Arduino controller) over a WebSocket fabric on Ethernet.

Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing (5.2x speedup, 56.7 to 10.9 ms) and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors via an I2C mux for contact-aware grasping; implemented two-link inverse kinematics on Arduino in embedded C++.

Triaged 11 integration failures to 100% pick reliability over 10 validation trials; deployed the Jetson bridge as a Linux systemd service with auto-restart, non-root isolation, and static IP networking.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS2 Humble and ROS1 Noetic.
Executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on the physical UR5e via the UR ROS2 driver; AL5B repeatability under 2 mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 monitoring firmware in bare-metal embedded C with timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed GPIO, TIM2, ADC1 and I2C1 directly at 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM with a deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified in Proteus.
